description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). CONSERVATIVE / lowest-precision lens. Generalized CLASS of the P306 decent M-02 miss: a fee/validation layer (UTB + UTBFeeCollector) wraps an underlying cross-chain action (DecentEthRouter.bridge/bridgeWithPayload), but that underlying action is itself PUBLIC with no caller restriction, so users bypass the fee layer by calling the router directly. Two-signal: S1 the codebase has a fee layer (a *FeeCollector* contract or a collectFees/chargeFee function); S2 a router/adapter exposes a PUBLIC cross-chain action (bridge/send/sendAndCall/swap) with no onlyX/auth modifier AND that does not itself invoke the fee layer. Fire LOW confidence. Suppress: action fns carrying an access modifier or that collect fees; codebases with no fee layer; views.

fp_controls.two_signal_required: S1 a fee layer exists in scope AND S2 a public unguarded cross-chain action that does NOT itself collect fees.
fp_controls.fee_invoker_suppression: the fee-charging entrypoint itself (invokes collectFees/retrieveAndCollectFees) -> suppressed.
fp_controls.low_confidence: this lens is advisory/low-precision; a public entrypoint may be intended.
